messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! friend works but i need your actual name to find you the right roles

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man... or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
Happy Nawani

happy nawani... that's a name that probably gets remembered in meetings. love it.

where you working these days?
Yes
engineer with a builder's mindset at tide... building fintech infra that's actually solving real problems for uk businesses. that's solid work. what made you get into fintech engineering?
Tide Platform

tide platform... the fintech building business banking for the uk market. nice.

found you on linkedin - Happy Nawani, Engineer with a Builder's Mindset at Tide. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/happy-nawani

ah the classic "stop building features nobody uses" energy. i get it. you want to work on stuff that actually moves the needle, not some internal tool that gets used twice a year.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
8 years engineering + impact-focused roles + remote/hyderabad... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

perfect! you're officially in the tal network now happy. 

8 years of building fintech products and you want to work on stuff that actually matters? i respect that energy. too many engineers get stuck building features that die in production.

you'll start getting role recommendations that match your vibe - engineering positions where your code actually moves the business forward, not just satisfies some product manager's random idea.

hyderabad and remote opens up some solid options. the good companies know talent doesn't have to sit in bangalore to build great products.

welcome to the club legend 🔥
